Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
The Impact You Will Create 
Back-End Engineering & Architecture: Conception, construction and implementation of robust data warehouse structures (classic cloud).
Advanced Data Modeling (SAP & Cloud): Development of complex, high-performance data models and customized logics both in classic environments and directly in the
SAP Datasphere as well as in cloud data warehouses.
Data Provisioning, Analytics & Frontend Reporting: End-to-end data provisioning from various source systems as well as the conceptual and visual creation of professional frontend reports and dashboards using state-of-the-art Bl tools.
Strategy & Tech-Stack Optimization: Continuous evaluation and optimization of (cloud) technologies using sound SQL and development knowledge; mentoring of specialist departments and knowledge transfer.
 Experience And Skills You Will Need
5 + years of in-depth practical experience in the SAP, cloud and DWH environment (full stack from data modeling to the finished frontend report)
Experienced and agile data expert with a strong focus on modern data warehouse architectures; combines in-depth technical SAP know-how with modern cloud expertise and strong front-end reporting skills.
Previous experience in designing and implementing high-performance data models in both classic SAP environments and modern cloud architectures
 SAP Expertise 
Data Warehousing: SAP BW 4 HANA, SAP BW on HANA
Modeling & Development: SQL, HANA Studio, ABAP (OO, CDS Views development of customized logic and interfaces)
Cloud Data Management & Modeling: SAP Datasphere (including native data modeling),
Frontend Reporting & Analytics: SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) - Solid knowledge in creating dashboards and reports Cloud & Bl ecosystem (Google world & others)
Foundation: Completed studies in (business) informatics or a comparable qualification with a clear focus on data management and business intelligence.
Agility: Proven in agile and cross-functional work structures.
Mentality: Hands-on, solution-oriented and future-oriented (always thinking one step ahead in terms of technology).
 Bonus Skills
SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC)
Cloud Data Platforms: Google BigQuery, Snowflake
Database Programming: Solid SQL knowledge for the Google world (BigQuery)
Business Intelligence & Frontend Reporting: Looker - Solid knowledge in creating reports and data visualizations
 Our Offer 
25 days annual leave + 1 day annual leave after 5 years in the company
Meal tickets
Additional health insurance
A good work life balance with flexible working time
A pleasant and diverse environment with regular events, team buildings and stimulating activities
A huge array of tools & technologies available on the spot and ready for a steady personal development
Variety of opportunities with one of the strongest and largest retail companies in the world
You will be part of an international team composed of people from different countries and backgrounds
Onboarding and support/mentoring
